title: Longest Unique Run
description: Given a string, find the length of the longest contiguous fragment in which every character appears at most once.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the string.
outputFormat: Print the length of the longest fragment with no repeated character.
hints: Use a sliding window and move the left boundary whenever a duplicate enters the window.

examples.explanation: The longest unique fragment is bcaefg or caefgh, both of length 6.
A unique fragment can contain only one a.
